beats.headline: A dart in his leg
beats.text: Carl takes Emberus's memorial crystal into his inventory, and then he notices something odd: a dart sticking out of his leg. He did not feel it and cannot feel it now, and he does not know when he got it or how. He gently pulls it out. Tracking Tag. The Kyryap has claimed you. Fucked = you. He jumps into his debuffs to see whether it has left anything there. There is something new, but it concerns his Emberus ring, not this. His hope is that the Kyryap, whatever it is, dies in the floor collapse.

relations.note: the tag says the Kyryap has claimed him
